name: IO Blobs
tagline: An agar-style arena. Everyone who opens your link swims in it with you.
description:
Press Invite in the bar above the game and send the link. Everyone who opens it drops into the same arena.

You are a small coloured blob. Steer, swallow the dots, grow. Bigger blobs swallow smaller ones, and a spiked ball knocks a chunk off you if you get greedy. On your own, a few wandering blobs keep you company; they scatter the moment another person arrives.

On a computer, point the mouse, or use WASD or the arrows. Space is a burst of speed that costs a little size. On a phone, put a thumb down and drag; Boost is the same burst.

An unofficial port of example-.io-game by vzhou842, MIT-licensed.
